data.exact_reserve_text:
Losses and loss adjustment expenses are GBP 35.6m higher than 2015 resulting in an increase in the loss ratio from 54.3% to 67.3%. The main driver for the increase is due to adverse prior year development of GBP 10.3m as compared to GBP 9.3m favorable prior year development during the same period in 2015.

The adverse development in 2016 is mainly attributable to the Personal Accident line of business which during 2016 booked losses from prior years (GBP 6.0m). There were also prior year losses in Property and DUAL Australia that contributed to the higher loss ratio. Excluding prior year development, the loss ratio for 2016 was 59.9% against last year of 62.9%.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Prior year losses in Property and DUAL Australia that contributed to the higher loss ratio (amount not quantified).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened the year with gross claims outstanding of GBP 223.495m. During 2016 there was adverse prior-year reserve development of GBP 10.3m (strengthening), driven primarily by prior-year losses in the Personal Accident class (GBP 6.0m) and additional prior year deterioration in Property/DUAL Australia. The reported figure in the narrative appears to be a net measure; no explicit gross prior-year movement figure was presented in the technical reserves movement note.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (insurance liabilities column) was located in the 'movement in prior year's provision' note; the report narrative quotes an adverse prior year development figure of GBP 10.3m which appears to be a NET measure (used here). The technical movement table shows 'Movement per technical account' (gross GBP 32.827m) but that line includes current-year developments and is not the prior-year-only movement. A gross prior-year-only figure was not found; prior_year_development_gbp_m therefore uses the narrative (net) figure and is flagged accordingly.
